quantitative_conclusions: Relative to actual L200 best parents, best AbsRel decreases only .000213487, CI[-.000643237,+.000140481]; all three seed differences negative but scene CI crosses zero. F1 decreases .012520764 CI[-.016841048,-.009060320] and band error decreases .002758536 CI[-.004880006,-.001059242], both directions agree across all seeds. Final versus actual Lbest also F1 worse and band better; overall three metrics cross zero.

Same-endpoint Sfinal versus Lfinal F1 improvement .041702447 is not the increment over its actual Lbest parent: it includes the known L200 seed112 late edge deterioration. Keep actual-parent and same-endpoint comparisons separate.

Compared with S100 best, only band error CI excludes zero in favor of S200, and seed114 reverses direction. Other four CIs cross zero. At final only F1 CI excludes zero favoring S200. Adding 100 images also expands covered scenes100 to187; cannot isolate sample count from scene coverage.

Compared with J200 best, only F1 improves with CI excluding zero, all three seeds agree. At final AbsRel and F1 improve with CI excluding zero. Against R200, only band error improves with CI excluding zero at both endpoints. Against B0, overall three metrics and band improve at both endpoints; best F1 CI crosses zero while final F1 improves.
Final versus best mean F1 improves .002859946 CI[.001616756,.004098222], all seeds agree; remaining four CIs cross zero. Best remains selected by predefined AbsRel, never by final F1.

Third seed best600, stop1000; final AbsRel .095072144 is .16749% above best .094913173. The raw improvement over initial parent .095078315 is below .2%, so patience anchor stays step0 and ten validation checks trigger normal stop. Four post-best evaluations retained. Training loss decreases .04309 to .04214 while validation stays on a small plateau; no sustained large degradation.

All S200 stable from own step0 because frozen Lbest already meets the within1%-of-best definition. This does not mean training is free: full parent selection costs are included. Mean own trajectory522.460448s; whole route1491.040281s, mean whole3233.333 attempted steps; total process wall1512.157473s. Own1720.458496MiB, whole route4019.692383MiB. Trainable27089; inference adaptation100817. No S200 skips or failures.

Scene CIs are 2000 paired scene bootstrap replicates over62 validation scenes after averaging matched seeds per image, random seed320119; no multiplicity adjustment. Seed SD is separately reported, not a population training-uncertainty CI. Twelve raw predictions rescored nine metrics/counts exactly; finite positive480x640; all16 LoRA tensors bitwise unchanged against actual parent at both endpoints.

visual_observations.nyuv2_0005: Best and final table/chair shapes are nearly indistinguishable. Both reduce whiteboard-area error versus B0 but increase broad wall error; whiteboard boundary remains red/missed. F1 .3262 to .3251, both below B0 .369; depth .07736 to .07867, final slightly worse than B0 .0783.
visual_observations.nyuv2_0598: The right tabletop edge remains mostly missed in both S panels unlike more continuous cyan in B0; final has slightly less cyan along the tabletop. F1 .4688 to .4585, both below B0 .537, despite depth .04622/.04677 slightly better than B0 .0481. Fine legs remain missed.
visual_observations.nyuv2_1440: Final introduces extra thin chair-post prediction fragments visible in depth and yellow edge overlays; chair and counter error is brighter. Predicted edges3306 to3707 but F1 .5211 to .4761, AbsRel .09440 to .09842, both depth endpoints worse than B0 .0882. More detected edges is not automatically more accurate structure.
visual_observations.nyuv2_0226: Both S checkpoints substantially reduce wall/person/column scale error from B0 .5841 to .1753/.1809. Final has slightly fewer false yellow branch fragments, giving F1 .4871 to .4969, while fine furniture remains missed and F1 stays below B0 .509. Depth slightly worsens after best.
visual_observations.nyuv2_0246: Both checkpoints retain the false ceiling line and missed fine shelf/table structures; final foreground cyan edge is a little more continuous. F1 .5061 to .5160; broad wall and shelf error stays much brighter than B0, AbsRel .1919/.1925 versus B0 .1129. Local boundary gain does not imply better global depth.
visual_observations.nyuv2_0080: Positive endpoint counterexample: final extends cyan matches along the central shelf post and small lower segment. F1 .1508 to .3191, predicted edges102 to250; best is slightly below B0 .162 and final above. Depth remains essentially .0874 at both endpoints, better than B0 .0986. Most fine shelf boundaries are still missed; nonconstant finite raw depth verified.

interpretation: S200 provides little extra global accuracy over the trained LoRA best parent and trades lower boundary-band depth error for lower boundary F1. This is a depth-value correction with limited and sample-dependent structure recovery, not a uniformly superior boundary model.
